mapper.sql: SELECT CITD.id, CITD.creator, CITD.create_time, CITD.modifier, CITD.modify_time, CITD.logic_del, CITD.rec_ver, CITD.build_in, CITD.tenant_id, CITD.header_id, CITD.name, CITD.`grouping`, CITD.order_num, CITD.remark, CITD.icon_tree_type, CITD.ICON_ID FROM COMMON_ICON_TEMPLATE_DETAIL CITD
mapper.select: SELECT CITD.NAME AS label, CITD.ID AS `value` FROM common_icon_template_detail CITD WHERE 1 = 1 AND CITD.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND CITD.HEADER_ID = #{dto.headerId} AND CITD.ICON_TREE_TYPE = 'R' ORDER BY CITD.ORDER_NUM

SELECT DISTINCT CITD.ID, CITD.REC_VER, CITD.LOGIC_DEL, CITD.HEADER_ID, CITD.NAME, CITD.`GROUPING`, CITD.ORDER_NUM, CITD.REMARK, CITD.ICON_TREE_TYPE, CITD.ICON_ID, CITD.PARENT_ID, SO.URL FROM common_icon_template_detail CITD LEFT JOIN common_icon CI ON CITD.ICON_ID = CI.ID LEFT JOIN SYS_OSS SO ON CI.FILE_ID = SO.ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CITD.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND CITD.HEADER_ID = #{dto.headerId} ORDER BY CITD.ORDER_NUM
